  "pros": [
    "Keeps all course management tasks, files, and communication in one place.",
    "Straightforward interface makes it easy for the team to adopt and use for tracking progress.",
    "Provides good value for money, especially with its flat-rate pricing for a small non-profit."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Lacks advanced project management features like complex reporting or task dependencies for detailed course tracking.",
    "The search function for older information can be frustrating and inefficient.",
    "Customization options are limited, which might hinder adapting it perfectly to specific non-profit workflows."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This founder likely found Basecamp to be a reliable and efficient tool for managing courses and tracking community progress, appreciating its simplicity and ability to consolidate communications and tasks. While its core features met most needs for a small non-profit, they may have occasionally desired more advanced reporting or customization options. Overall, the platform offered good value and kept the team organized without overwhelming them with complexity."
